references.text: The same principle that sin is made known, applied to the congregation's sin
Parallel text about a sin offering for an ordinary person, with the same wording that sin is made known
Requirement of a flawless male animal (זָכָר תָּמִים) as an offering
Goat (שְׂעִיר עִזִּים) used as a sin offering
Requirement for unblemished animals to be accepted as offerings
Goat as a sin offering for unintentional sin
Confession of sin and presentation of the sin offering
Christ as the perfect sin offering who replaces animal sacrifices
